question: The average score of 5 players of a cricket team is 55. It is also observed that 3 of these 5 players have an average score of 55. What will be the average score of the remaining two players?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

If the overall average of a group is equal to the average of a specific subset, the average of the remaining subset must also be exactly the same.

Net deviation of the 3 players from overall average = 3 × (55 − 55) = 0.

To balance the total average, the net deviation of the remaining 2 players must also be 0.

Average of the remaining 2 players = 55 + (0 ÷ 2) = 55.

**∴ The correct answer is 55.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total number of players = 5

Overall average score of 5 players = 55

Average score of 3 of these players = 55

**Formula Used:**

Average = Sum of values ÷ Number of values

Sum of values = Average × Number of values

 Total 5 Players: Overall Average = 55
 
• 
 
• 
 
• 

 
 3 Players
 Average = 55
 
 
 2 Players
 Average = ?
 
 Result: Required Average = 55

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total score of all 5 players = 5 × 55 = 275

⇒ Total score of the 3 players = 3 × 55 = 165

⇒ Score of the remaining 2 players = Total score of 5 players − Total score of 3 players

⇒ Score of the remaining 2 players = 275 − 165 = 110

⇒ Average score of the remaining 2 players = 110 ÷ 2 = 55

**∴ The correct answer is 55.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Combined Average

When two groups with sizes n₁ and n₂ have individual averages A₁ and A₂, the combined average is calculated as: A = (n₁A₁ + n₂A₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂).

Net Deviation Method

The sum of all deviations of a set of observations from their arithmetic average is always equal to zero. Deviation is calculated as (Observation value − Average).

Weighted Average

Used when items have different frequencies or weights. Weighted Average = (w₁x₁ + w₂x₂ + ... + wₙxₙ) ÷ (w₁ + w₂ + ... + wₙ).
